#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
task_dir="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
workspace_dir=/dwdhome/fy/BASE_E6_2_copy
cd -- "$workspace_dir"
action="${1:-read}"
if (( $# )); then shift; fi
case "$action" in
  read)
    exec "$workspace_dir/run-python.sh" "$task_dir/run_in_runtime.py" "$task_dir/read_all.py" "$task_dir/readback" "$@"
    ;;
  rerun)
    exec "$workspace_dir/run-python.sh" "$task_dir/run_in_runtime.py" "$task_dir/run_and_export.py" "$@"
    ;;
  inspect)
    exec "$workspace_dir/run-python.sh" "$task_dir/run_in_runtime.py" "$task_dir/source/实例运行脚本.py" --mode inspect --output-dir "$task_dir/inspect" "$@"
    ;;
  *) printf '用法: bash %s {inspect|rerun|read}\n' "$0" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 使用本工作区的 Python 环境，并兼容当前主机的 TLS 动态库。
set -eo pipefail
workspace_dir="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd -- "$workspace_dir"
mkdir -p "$workspace_dir/.migration/records"
source "$workspace_dir/m3rc" 2> "$workspace_dir/.migration/records/m3rc.log"

# 旧 beacon 无法解析时，按到 Gogs 的内网路由确定本机服务地址。
if [[ -z "${M3HOST:-}" ]]; then
  M3HOST="$(python - <<'PY'
import socket
with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as sock:
    sock.connect(("gogs.dw", 443))
    print(sock.getsockname()[0])
PY
)"
  export M3HOST
fi

export NO_PROXY="${NO_PROXY:+${NO_PROXY},}${M3HOST},localhost,127.0.0.1,gogs.dw"
export no_proxy="${NO_PROXY}"

# 使用本工作区的独立加密依赖，兼容下方 PostgreSQL TLS 设置。
runtime_deps="$workspace_dir/.runtime/python-deps"
if [[ -d "$runtime_deps" ]]; then
  export PYTHONPATH="${runtime_deps}:${PYTHONPATH}"
fi

# 当前共享 Anaconda 的 TLS 库在 PostgreSQL 握手时会崩溃。
# 只为本次进程加载本机已验证的系统库，保持数据库 TLS 连接。
tls_libraries="/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libssl.so.3:/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcrypto.so.3"
export LD_PRELOAD="${tls_libraries}${LD_PRELOAD:+:${LD_PRELOAD}}"
ulimit -c 0
exec python "$@"
